subject.title: [Bug] Webchat avatar endpoint /avatar/{agentId} returns 404 even with valid IDENTITY.md avatar

question: Should oversized or otherwise rejected local avatars be reported only through safe `/avatar/{agentId}?meta=1` metadata and Control UI diagnostics, or should the direct `/avatar/{agentId}` image endpoint return more specific failure statuses?
rationale: The remaining choice affects an authenticated local workspace file-serving route, so better UX must be balanced against information-disclosure and compatibility expectations.

options.title: Use metadata and UI diagnostics
options.body: Keep the direct image route conservative while surfacing safe `avatarStatus` and `avatarReason` guidance in Control UI for missing or oversized local avatars.

options.title: Expose specific endpoint statuses
options.body: Return statuses such as 413 or 400 from the direct avatar route only with tests proving no local paths or unsafe policy details leak.

options.title: Fold into the broader avatar contract
options.body: Handle the remaining local diagnostics together with the open remote-avatar Control UI contract in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/41201.

recommendation.title: Use metadata and UI diagnostics
recommendation.body: Keep the direct image route conservative while surfacing safe `avatarStatus` and `avatarReason` guidance in Control UI for missing or oversized local avatars.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest combined history on agent avatar support, local avatar safety limits, and Gateway avatar route hardening.
